items.title: Lew Tabackin interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 17, 1999
items.q: I was a classmate of Frankie Avalon and Chubby Checker

ctx.x: Oh yeah that’s right. Fabian and all those guys.

Yeah. I was a classmate of Frankie Avalon and Chubby Checker and all those kind of people. So I had no interest in that. It wasn’t good for your social life, so that was a problem, but I mean I was really dogmatic and inflexible and I knew what was supposed to be happening and what wasn’t happening. But it was interesting. But anyway the flute thing began, so I transferred some flute stuff to the tenor, and I could play two, three octave jumps. I mean I could figure out how to do that. And by using and dealing…
Just for the effect and it sometimes wasn’t very musical.
